name: Archive workshop
desc: A .zip read entry by entry into a table, unpacked and made -- and every handler in it is a flowchart on the Steps tab rather than a page of code: a repeat over the archive, a row added for each entry, totals kept as it goes. The rest are rules. All of it is System.IO.Compression through AHK#, with the slow two in the background.
vars:
zipPath = ""
entries = 0
packed = 0
unpacked = 0
saved <- (unpacked > 0 ? Round((unpacked - packed) * 100 / unpacked) : 0)
hasZip <- (zipPath != "" && FileExist(zipPath) != "")
said <- (entries ? entries " entries, " saved "% smaller" : "No archive open")
unpackTo = A_Desktop "\\unpacked"
packFrom = ""

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Archive workshop
windows.status: msg | Open a .zip, or pack a folder into one | grow icon=F012
windows.flows:
unpackBtn Click -> status msg Unpacking in the background...
unpackBtn Click -> call Unpack zipPath, unpackTo
unpackBtn Click -> status msg Unpacked.
clearBtn Click -> clearlist entriesTable
clearBtn Click -> assign entries 0
clearBtn Click -> assign packed 0
clearBtn Click -> assign unpacked 0
windows.binds:
pathBox <-> zipPath
readBtn.Enabled <- hasZip
unpackBtn.Enabled <- hasZip
sumLabel.Text <- said

kids.name: tip
kids.arg: Open a .zip and every entry becomes a row. Read it is a flowchart on the Steps tab -- a repeat over the archive, a row added for each entry, the totals kept as it goes -- and the other buttons are rules on the Logic tab. The three things it does are .NET methods made into your own functions on App > Libraries.

events.name: Click
Click
events.code:
entriesTable.Component.Clear()
entries := 0
packed := 0
unpacked := 0
for item in OpenArchive(zipPath).Entries {
    entriesTable.Component.AddRow({Key: item.FullName, name: item.FullName, size: item.Length, packed: item.CompressedLength})
    entries += 1
    unpacked += item.Length
    packed += item.CompressedLength
}
AxBindSync()

kids.name: entriesTable
kids.arg:
{Columns: [{Key: "name", Title: "Inside the archive", Width: 420, Icon: true},
           {Key: "size", Title: "Size", Width: 130, Align: "right", Sort: "number",
            Format: (v, *) => AxWindow.FileSize(v)},
           {Key: "packed", Title: "Packed", Width: 130, Align: "right", Sort: "number",
            Format: (v, *) => AxWindow.FileSize(v)}],
 Rows: [], Empty: "Open a .zip, or pack a folder into one."}

events.name: Click

adaptors:
OpenArchive | static |  | System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.OpenRead | path:string | object | Open a .zip and read what is inside it, without unpacking anything
Unpack | static |  | System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.ExtractToDirectory | source:string, target:string | void@async | Unpack the whole archive, in the background
PackFolder | static |  | System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory | folder:string, target:string | void@async | Pack a folder into a .zip, in the background
